title: Remove fibre equations from a compatible Cohen presentation
statement: Let $f:A\to B$ be a flat local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Suppose given power-series rings $R=\Lambda_R[[X_1,\ldots,X_n]]$ and $S=\Lambda_S[[Z_1,\ldots,Z_m]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], both regular local [def-weil-regular-scheme], local surjections $q:R\twoheadrightarrow A$ and $b:S\twoheadrightarrow B$, and a local map $i:R\to S$ with $bi=fq$. Suppose $t$ is a regular system of parameters of $R$ and $(i(t),z)$ is one of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters]. Assume either both coefficient rings are characteristic-zero fields, or both are Cohen rings for the same prime $p$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and the first entry of $t$ is $p$. Assume the closed fibre $B/\mathfrak m_A B$, with the quotient algebra structure over $A/\mathfrak m_A$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], is formally smooth for the image of $\mathfrak m_B$ [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Then there are $m'\ge0$, a regular local power-series ring $T=\Lambda_S[[Y_1,\ldots,Y_{m'}]]$, a surjection $v:T\twoheadrightarrow B$, a local map $j:R\to T$ and a list $y$ in $T$ such that $vj=fq$, $\ker(v)=(\ker(q))T$, $(j(t),y)$ is a regular system of parameters of $T$, and $T/\mathfrak m_R T$ is formally smooth over $R/\mathfrak m_R$ for the image of $\mathfrak m_T$. No formal smoothness of $j$ or $f$ is asserted.

proof.text: Construct a regular local power-series quotient model T with the commuting surjective presentation, the required remaining parameters and the smooth closed fibre, but only the fibre-level kernel containment ker v contained in m_R T. This step uses no flatness of f.

Apply the flat-target kernel rigidity theorem to q,f,j,v. It upgrades the fibre-level kernel containment to ker v=(ker q)T. Assemble the original existential conclusion with the parameter and smoothness witnesses from the first step.

theorem exists_flat_closedFiber_powerSeries_model
    (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom f] (hflat : f.Flat)
    (ΛR ΛS : Type w) [CommRing ΛR] [CommRing ΛS] (n m : ℕ)
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR)]
    [IsRegularLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛS)]
    (q : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR →+* A) [IsLocalHom q]
    (b : MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛS →+* B) [IsLocalHom b]
    (i : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR →+* MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛS) [IsLocalHom i]
    (hq : Function.Surjective q) (hb : Function.Surjective b)
    (hcomm : b.comp i = f.comp q)
    (t : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR))
    (z : List (MvPowerSeries (Fin m) ΛS))
    (ht : IsRegularSystemOfParameters t)
    (hz : IsRegularSystemOfParameters (t.map i ++ z))
    (hcoeff : (IsField ΛR ∧ IsField ΛS ∧ CharZero ΛR ∧ CharZero ΛS) ∨
      ∃ p : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ IsCohenRing p ΛR ∧ IsCohenRing p ΛS ∧
        t.head? = some (p : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR)) :
    letI : Algebra A B := f.toAlgebra
    let I : Ideal B := Ideal.map f (maximalIdeal A)
    letI : Algebra (A ⧸ maximalIdeal A) (B ⧸ I) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.algebraQuotientOfLEComap (Ideal.le_comap_map :
        maximalIdeal A ≤ I.comap (algebraMap A B))
    Algebra.FormallySmoothAdic (A ⧸ maximalIdeal A) (B ⧸ I)
        (Ideal.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) (maximalIdeal B)) →
    ∃ m' : ℕ, let T := MvPowerSeries (Fin m') ΛS
      ∃ (_ : IsRegularLocalRing T)
        (v : T →+* B) (j : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR →+* T),
        Function.Surjective v ∧ IsLocalHom j ∧
        v.comp j = f.comp q ∧ RingHom.ker v = (RingHom.ker q).map j ∧
        ∃ y : List T, IsRegularSystemOfParameters (t.map j ++ y) ∧
          (let R := MvPowerSeries (Fin n) ΛR
           letI : Algebra R T := j.toAlgebra
           let L : Ideal T := (maximalIdeal R).map j
           letI : Algebra (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) (T ⧸ L) :=
             Ideal.Quotient.algebraQuotientOfLEComap (Ideal.le_comap_map :
               maximalIdeal R ≤ L.comap (algebraMap R T))
           Algebra.FormallySmoothAdic (R ⧸ maximalIdeal R) (T ⧸ L)
             ((maximalIdeal T).map (Ideal.Quotient.mk L)))
